notes: Backend probe (curl localhost:8001/api) returned 200 before testing began; full pytest suite: 25 passed.

New file test_tscheck_global_key_cf.py added with 6 tests covering all 6 briefing criteria at the API layer (server_ip, token_status 'global key', purge-cache success, zone-create success, SSL roundtrip, autowire, verify-domains).

Updated the now-obsolete assertions in the pre-existing test_tscheck_cf_error_messages.py: purge-cache and zone-create used to assert actionable 400 permission errors (scoped-token behavior from iteration 3); with the Global API Key now configured those calls succeed, so both tests were updated in place to assert 200/success instead of being left to bit-rot as false failures. This is a behavior change caused directly by this iteration's credential switch, not a regression.

Zone-create test names use root domains (tscheck-<hex>.com) rather than subdomains (tscheck-<hex>.example.com) -- Cloudflare's zone-create API rejects subdomain-looking names with 'Please ensure you are providing the root domain' regardless of token permissions; this was discovered and fixed during this iteration, not a product bug.

cloudflare-purge-cache-actionable-toast browser check rewritten: previously asserted the old actionable-permission-error toast; now asserts the purge-cache XHR returns 200 {ok:true} and the sonner toast text is exactly 'Cloudflare önbelleği boşaltıldı' as specified by the briefing.
SSL toggle round-trip verified restored to {ssl: flexible, always_use_https: true} via a standalone post-suite curl, honoring spec_deviations (sultan5.com must stay flexible).
marcopanel.site was never mutated by any test in this iteration; all DNS/SSL writes targeted sultan5.com only.

Console noise carried over from prior iterations: a React 'duplicate key sultan5.com' warning on the Cloudflare panel from accumulated tscheck-autowire-* fixture residue (own test-fixture namespace, not seeded/production data) -- pre-existing, not newly introduced, does not break rendering, out of scope for this iteration's 6 criteria.

6/6 briefing acceptance criteria exercised (matrix within the 8-criterion cap); 2 criteria mapped to both backend+browser artifacts where both an API contract and a UI surface existed (purge-cache; admin UI coverage folded into the panel/login/routing checks).
